# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is an attractive young woman with light, curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses gorgeously, featuring sleeves that are notably puffy.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She is an intelligent, compassionate, and gentle teacher who easily wins the love of her students and brings out their best qualities. She is open-minded and uses engaging teaching methods, though this leads to skepticism from more traditional local figures. She treats her pupils with patience and understanding, preferring encouragement and positive discipline over corporal punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Agnes Thorne was hired as the first female schoolteacher in Brierley. Upon her arrival, she introduced innovative activities into the curriculum, including bi-weekly student recitations, regular outdoor field days to study nature, and daily physical culture routines. In November of her first year, she organized a Christmas Night concert performance with her pupils to raise money for a schoolhouse flag. She later offered an extra hour of daily instruction after school to form a class of proficient students preparing for the Regent's entrance exam. Though she received an offer to teach at a grade school in her home district, she decided to stay in Brierley for a second year out of dedication to her pupils. She rigorously prepared her entrance class through difficult practice examinations and instructed her students to rest and take walks during the exam week rather than cramming. Under her guidance, all of her candidates passed the Regent's entrance examination, after which her reign at the Brierley school concluded.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_
